answer: One defence is Proof of unique Substack subscriber history: a newsletter paid for by subscribers for two years, and the delta of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Because a newsletter paid for by subscribers for two years, a fresh identity starts with nothing: it must earn its standing the slow way, while the prism for an established agent is already paid and proven. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the pulse of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
